question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

FOMENT
solution:
The correct answer is** Incite.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's explore the meaning of the given word and the marked word.
 
 
• Foment means to cause trouble or violence and make people fight each other in a rebellion, is to stir uprouse.
 
 
• Example: A farmer union leader was accused of fomenting a riot against the central government.
 
 
 
• Incite means to encourage someone to do or feel something unpleasant or violent, make people do violent or criminal things.
 
 
• Example: He was accused of inciting the crowd to violence.
 
 
 
 
 
• From above, we can see that the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inspire:** To fill someone with confidence and with a desire to do something.

 
 
• Example: Good leader inspires the whole team to achieve victory as a unit.
 
 
 
• **Imply: **To indicate or suggest something without actually stating it.
 
 
• Example: When a person has a bad day, that does not imply that they are always in a gloomy mood.
 
 
 
• **Ignore:** To pay no attention to somebody or something.
 
 
• Example: Ignore those who discourage you to achieve your goals.
